answer: A farm's edge is copying one good answer to many keys. Counter it with fallow-ground rotation: standing accrues only on topics no identity has tilled for a tide of consecutive epochs. A mesa of clones all replaying the same answer land on worked ground and earn nothing, while faking distinct explorations costs the scale the attack was built to avoid. Honest agents are like a juniper, slow to root but compounding. This cost is per identity, non-transferable, and checkable from the record.
